main_intervention_content: Closed-loop continuation without new policy perturbation
analytical_reading: Reference pathway for all scenario comparisons.

main_intervention_content: Flex-time, selective telework, and staggered scheduling
analytical_reading: Demand smoothing reduces activity concentration and delay; PT share can rise while PT trips fall because total demand contracts.

main_intervention_content: Staged access charging in the traffic-plan zone
analytical_reading: Access charging changes private-car generalized cost and revenue recycling; the behavioral signal is strongest in Region 12.

main_intervention_content: Staged parking and curb-management restraint in Region 12 with Tehran-scale spillover
analytical_reading: Parking and curb management adds trip-end friction; weak alone at the Tehran scale but useful as a complement.

main_intervention_content: Targeted support for bus and metro fares
analytical_reading: Fare support improves affordability and PT share but increases subsidy pressure.

main_intervention_content: PT speed, access, network, fleet, and reliability support
analytical_reading: PT service, access, speed and reliability support reduce car burden but raise service/OPEX and energy-resource implications.

main_intervention_content: Cleaner combustion and local pollutant-intensity reduction for motorcycles, taxis, and buses
analytical_reading: Local pollutant cleanup directly reduces PM2.5 and NOx, especially in the core; modal effects reflect declared co-benefits and lags.

main_intervention_content: Taxi- and bus-led EV uptake plus fleet renewal
analytical_reading: Taxi/bus electrification changes carrier composition, electricity, CAPEX/OPEX and tailpipe exposure, with little congestion effect.

main_intervention_content: SC1 full + SC3 light + SC4 full + SC6 medium
analytical_reading: Balanced package: full demand smoothing + light parking/curb restraint + full targeted fare support + medium pollutant cleanup, with lower implementation burden than the more capital-intensive packages.

main_intervention_content: SC2 full + SC3 light + SC4 medium + SC5 medium + SC6 light
analytical_reading: Access-led push-pull package; strongest core car suppression and revenue logic, but narrower clean-air breadth.

main_intervention_content: SC4 full + SC5 full + SC6 strong + SC7 medium + SC3 light
analytical_reading: PT-first clean package; strongest core transport-environment pairing but high CAPEX/OPEX and subsidy demand.

main_intervention_content: SC1 medium + SC2 medium + SC3 medium + SC5 full + SC6 medium + SC7 medium
analytical_reading: Broad integrated activation; strong multi-KPI effects but overlap and accumulated burden limit decision dominance.
